objective: Add mission-scoped Agent Intercom, governed delegation, durable peer sessions, delivery receipts, replay, and Mission Room Handoffs without changing FGC/AEF/F07 authority.

rulesConsidered: Comms does not grant execution authority.
Mission scope is the minimum collaboration security boundary.
FGC/Guardian remain authorization and mutation boundaries.
No second broker or authoritative state store is introduced.

changes: Mission-scoped Agent Intercom built on Comms Fabric v2 and DurableEventBus.
Dedicated intercom message kind and capability.
Durable in-memory/disk/Mongo message, delegation, and session state.
Explicit delivery lifecycle and bounded retry/dead-letter.
Idempotent sends and explicit replay cursor.
Peer hello protocol check and capability/schema negotiation.
Delegation acceptance restricted to the target principal.
Managed-agent capability eligibility enforced for delegated capability requests.
Mission Room Handoffs surface and intercom projection.
Authenticated mission intercom and session APIs.
